title: 1994 AMC 8 Problem 3
statement: Each day Maria must work \(8\) hours. This does not include the \(45\) minutes she takes for lunch. If she begins working at \(7{:}25\) A.M. and takes her lunch break at noon, then her working day will end at

solutions.text:
Eight hours after \(7{:}25\) A.M. is \(3{:}25\) P.M.

Adding the \(45\)-minute lunch break gives an ending time of \(4{:}10\) P.M.

Thus, the correct answer is C .
hints: The workday spans \(8\) hours of work plus the \(45\)-minute lunch break
Add \(8\) hours to \(7{:}25\) A.M., then add \(45\) more minutes
